narr: A strong synoptic system with heavy rainfall during warm front passage followed by additional rainfall during the severe thunderstorms along the cold front led to reports of flooding in northern portions of East Tennessee. Additionally, strong winds powered by strong winds aloft mixed to the surface, bringing wind advisory conditions to the whole area, a few high wind reports, and some wind damage.
ev: Reports of 3 to 4 foot deep water over the intersection of Turkey Branch Road and Hurricane Road. Also several reports of water over the road on Highway 58 between Coeburn and Norton.
